description: AlphaFold v6 per-residue pLDDT for Q9H9K5 around the cleavage site, with an explicit model-quality caveat
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
seq="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9H9K5.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
pdb=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q9H9K5-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text
print("len",len(pdb))
plddt={}; ca={}
for ln in pdb.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[12:16].strip()=="CA":
        r=int(ln[22:26]); plddt[r]=float(ln[60:66])
        ca[r]=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
res=np.array(sorted(plddt)); p=np.array([plddt[r] for r in res])
print(f"modelled {res.min()}-{res.max()}  global mean pLDDT={p.mean():.1f}  (AFDB reports 44.3 -> LOW CONFIDENCE MODEL)")
def blk(a,b,lab):
    m=(res>=a)&(res<=b); print(f"  {lab:<38}{a:>4}-{b:<4} mean pLDDT={p[m].mean():6.1f} min={p[m].min():5.1f}")
print("\nper-region pLDDT:")
for a,b,l in [(27,432,'shed ectodomain 27-432'),(426,440,'cleavage loop P7..P8'),(429,436,'P4-P4 octamer'),
              (437,445,'CX6CC motif 437-445'),(446,488,'membrane-proximal 446-488'),
              (489,509,'transmembrane 489-509'),(510,563,'cytoplasmic 510-563')]: blk(a,b,l)
if 432 in ca and 489 in ca:
    print(f"\nCA(432)-CA(489) distance = {np.linalg.norm(ca[432]-ca[489]):.1f} A  (57 aa apart in sequence)")
for i,jj in [(437,444),(437,445),(444,445)]:
    if i in ca and jj in ca: print(f"CA({i})-CA({jj}) = {np.linalg.norm(ca[i]-ca[jj]):.1f} A")
print("\nCaveat: AFDB global pLDDT 44.3 (73% of residues very low). This model is NOT reliable for local-structure claims.")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,4.2))
ax.plot(res,p,lw=1.1,color='#2b6cb0')
for lo,hi,c,lab in [(27,432,'#bee3f8','shed ectodomain 27-432'),(437,445,'#d6bcfa','CX6CC 437-445'),
                    (446,488,'#9ae6b4','membrane-proximal 446-488'),(489,509,'#feb2b2','TM 489-509'),
                    (510,563,'#e2e8f0','cytoplasmic 510-563')]:
    ax.axvspan(lo,hi,color=c,alpha=.55,label=lab)
ax.axvline(432.5,color='k',lw=2); ax.text(432.5,103,'Q432/R433',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.axhline(70,ls=':',color='grey'); ax.axhline(50,ls=':',color='#c53030')
ax.set_xlabel('residue'); ax.set_ylabel('AlphaFold pLDDT (model v6, global 44.3)'); ax.set_ylim(0,110)
ax.set_title('Q9H9K5 AlphaFold confidence is low throughout, so the model cannot support local flexibility claims at Q432')
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5,ncol=3,loc='upper right'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
